static_traits.name: Lin Lei
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members in the city
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of friends who appreciate her work, but she finds it hard to open up to them about her unease and self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no history of psychological counseling or similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-reflect, highly cooperative, calm tone but prone to focusing on negative interpretations; able to describe thinking patterns and difficulties, with normal speech rate and logic

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel people are negatively judging my work, especially when I paint portraits for others. This feeling began a few months ago when my girlfriend smiled while I was painting her portrait.
basic_info.core_demands: I noticed that these self-doubts are interfering with my artistic expression and causing me distress, so I came to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: My work is not good enough; others will think it is poor
My worth depends on others' recognition of my work

special_situations.event: When painting a portrait of his girlfriend for her, the girlfriend laughed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person laughs or gives no serious positive feedback, it means my work is poor and they are mocking me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing his true intentions at the time with his girlfriend; reduces or pauses drawing portraits to avoid being 'laughed at' again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She is mocking me, thinking my painting is terrible.

special_situations.event: Each time starting to paint a portrait for an acquaintance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work does not immediately win the other party's liking or praise, it equals failure and I am a terrible artist
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Before and after creating, repeatedly seeks others' affirmation and reassurance; procrastinates on or avoids painting portraits
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will hate my work and may even laugh at me.

special_situations.event: Friends express support and appreciation for her work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is unreliable or 'just comfort', and cannot show that I really paint well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles the value of positive feedback, continuing to seek external recognition from more people
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just saying nice things; it does not count.

special_situations.event: Thinking about talking to girlfriend about the laughter at that time, clarifying its real meaning
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I ask, she will very likely confirm the conclusion I fear most: my work is poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding direct communication and reality testing, to avoid anxiety and shame in the short term
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Asking will prove I am bad at this, and the relationship will become even more awkward.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely recognized and appreciated by significant others (especially the partner and audiences)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being mocked and negated, thereby experiencing shame and a destroyed sense of worth, and even damaged relationships
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being negated by avoiding direct verification and seeking external reassurance, maintaining self-esteem and relational security

object_relations.self_representation: A creator who is not good enough and may be negated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Judges/audiences who are picky and mock or negate oneself

object_relations.self_representation: Someone who needs to be seen and soothed but finds it hard to trust positive feedback
object_relations.object_representation: Others who verbally support but are 'untrustworthy' (friends, audience)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others suggest she communicate directly with her girlfriend to clarify the meaning of the laughter at the time
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I go and ask, I will hear negation and mockery, thus confirming 'I am very bad'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In an empathic, slowly inquiring tone, first affirms their fear and shame, then invites them to list bearable, tiny communication steps, avoiding direct confrontation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing others' evaluation of works or recalling the scene of girlfriend laughing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will mock and belittle just as feared (attributing inner self-criticism to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains gentleness and neutrality, uses clarifying questions to distinguish feelings from facts, invites evidence and counter-evidence, and encourages first-person expression of subjective experience.

manifestations: Lives alone; finds it hard to open up unease and self-doubt to friends
Tense relationship with partner due to insecurity about his work; avoids direct communication
outcomes: Self-isolation and feelings of not being understood intensify

manifestations: Stopped or reduced painting due to self-doubt, losing a long-standing source of expression and sense of value
outcomes: Feels more alienated and 'somewhat lacking a sense of purpose'
Low mood and worsened anxiety; sleep disrupted

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Attributes inner self-critical experiences to 'they will dislike/laugh at my work'
Assumes negative intentions of others before verifying

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects and instead does it to themselves, redirecting outward energy toward the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Wants to clarify things with his partner but chooses not to speak, turning the anxiety and shame inward toward himself
Through self-doubt and withdrawal, 'protects himself' rather than engaging in outward contact

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively scrutinizes and negates himself before and after creating, constantly seeking external recognition
Overly cautious in relationships for fear of being negated

positive_force: 拥有支持其作品的朋友圈
Open to reality testing and small-step attempts (willing to jointly formulate concrete plans)
A long-standing artistic identity and investment provide a foundation for resuming creative work
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and disqualifying the positive
Excessive dependence on external approval; hard to internalize positive feedback
Avoids direct communication and reality testing to reduce anxiety in the short term
Anxiety and insecurity lead to avoidance of creating and to sleep disturbance

target_behavior.behavior: Shows marked anxiety and insecurity when drawing portraits of others, and tends to avoid or reduce drawing
antecedent: Starting or planning to paint portraits for others (especially acquaintances/partners)
Recalling the girlfriend's laughter while painting
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic anticipation of being negated and mind-reading interpretations, excessively tying self-worth to others' evaluations
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible negation and shame, reducing anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in creative output, strained relationships, increased emotional distress affecting sleep

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeking external validation and positive feedback in creation-related situations
antecedent: Feeling uneasy and self-doubt when completing works or preparing to create
Encountering others' reactions to the work (real or imagined)
target_behavior.core_reason: Inner self-evaluation system is weak, tending to use others' reactions as the main basis for self-worth
target_behavior.function: 获得短期安慰与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Dependence on external recognition is reinforced, negative beliefs remain uncorrected, and anxiety recurs
